project_summary: An HR automation and resume analysis workflow that creates forms, accepts candidate submissions, evaluates resumes against job descriptions, and generates GitHub- and project-based interview questions.
discovery_goals: Suggest features grounded in the analyzer form, submission, resume analysis, and interview-question flows.
Prefer recruiter and operator workflows that make candidate review faster and easier to understand.
Avoid lead-generation, payment, admin-dashboard, and marketing-site suggestions for this project.
backend_context: Analyzer routes support metadata, form creation, form submissions, resume-vs-JD analysis, and GitHub question generation.
Analyzer services include OCR extraction, resume matching, GitHub/project question generation, and file-backed storage.
The project already has reusable template, submission, and analysis entry points in the analyzer API.
frontend_context: Frontend scope should focus on analyzer-specific forms, submission review, score presentation, and recruiter workflows.
Do not treat shared lead-generation or payment screens as the primary context for this project.

feature_templates.title: Add analyzer form template library and cloning flow
acceptance_criteria: Users can start from curated analyzer form templates instead of building every form from scratch
Existing templates can be previewed and cloned into a new form
Analyzer form creation remains backward compatible

feature_templates.title: Add analyzer submission review workbench
acceptance_criteria: Users can review analyzer submissions with clearer status, timestamps, and submission metadata
Reviewers can open a submission and see all uploaded artifacts in one workflow
Analyzer submission and form flows remain green

feature_templates.title: Add analyzer score breakdown and recruiter summary
acceptance_criteria: Resume analysis results show a clearer score breakdown and short recruiter-facing summary
Users can understand why a resume matched or missed the job description

feature_templates.title: Add GitHub question review and export for analyzer
acceptance_criteria: Generated GitHub and project question sets are easier to review before an interview
Users can export or copy structured question packs
Analyzer GitHub question generation remains green
